    33	class StockBulkApprovalStoreAction
    34	{
    35	    public function __construct(
    36	        private readonly EntityManagerInterface $entityManager,
    37	        private readonly ProductStockEntityManager $productStockEntityManager,
    38	        private readonly StockEditApprovalEntityManager $stockEditApprovalEntityManager,
    39	        private readonly StockEditApprovalDetailEntityManager $stockEditApprovalDetailEntityManager,
    40	        private readonly StockHistoryEntityManager $stockHistoryEntityManager,
    41	        private readonly MtbStockHistorySourceTypeRepository $stockHistorySourceTypeRepository,
    42	        private readonly StockApprovalListEntityManager $stockApprovalListEntityManager,
    43	    ) {
    44	    }
    45	
    46	    public function handle(StockBulkApprovalStoreInput $input): void
    47	    {
    48	        if ($input->items === []) {
    49	            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Items must not be empty.');
    50	        }
    51	
    52	        $this->entityManager->beginTransaction();
    53	
    54	        try {
    55	            $now = new \DateTime();
    56	
    57	            // 承認データをこのタイミングで作成し、承認IDを確定させる。
    58	            $StockEditApproval = $this->stockEditApprovalEntityManager->save(
    59	                BaseInfo: $input->items[0]->ProductStock->getBaseInfo(),
    60	                StockChangeTypeDetail: $input->StockChangeTypeDetail,
    61	                approvalStatus: 1,// TODO: 承認ステータスのマスター化
    62	                registeredAt: $now,
    63	                RegisteredMember: $input->Member,
    64	                approvedAt: null,
    65	                ApprovalMember: null,
    66	            );
    67	            $this->entityManager->flush();
    68	
    69	            $StockChangeTypeDetail = $input->StockChangeTypeDetail;
    70	            $Member = $input->Member;
    71	
    72	            $totalInventoryChange = 0;
    73	            $totalCostChange = 0;
    74	            foreach ($input->items as $item) {
    75	                $totalInventoryChange += (int) $item->stockChangeQuantity;
    76	                $purchaseUnitPrice = ($item->purchasePrice === null || $item->purchasePrice === '') ? '0' : $item->purchasePrice;
    77	                $totalCostChange += $StockChangeTypeDetail->isTypeBeStocked()
    78	                    ? (int) bcmul($purchaseUnitPrice, (string) $item->stockChangeQuantity, 0)
    79	                    : (int) $item->ProductStock->getMovementTotalCost($item->stockChangeQuantity);
    80	                $this->processOne($item, $StockEditApproval, $StockChangeTypeDetail, $Member);
    81	            }
    82	
    83	            $HistorySourceType = $this->stockHistorySourceTypeRepository->get(MtbStockHistorySourceType::STOCK_BULK_EDIT);
    84	            $this->stockApprovalListEntityManager->save(
    85	                StockApprovalList: null,
    86	                BaseInfo: $input->items[0]->ProductStock->getBaseInfo(),
    87	                StockLocationId: $input->items[0]->ProductStock->getStockLocationId(),
    88	                HistorySourceType: $HistorySourceType,
    89	                historySourceId: $StockEditApproval->getId(),
    90	                StockTransferTypeDetail: $this->entityManager->getReference(MtbStockChangeTypeDetail::class, $StockChangeTypeDetail->getId()),
    91	                approvalStatus: DtbStockApprovalList::APPROVAL_STATUS_UNAPPROVED,
    92	                registeredDate: $now,
    93	                RegisteredMember: $Member,
    94	                approvedDate: null,
    95	                ApprovalMember: null,
    96	                ProductStockTotalCount: count($input->items),
    97	                InventoryChangeTotalCount: $totalInventoryChange,
    98	                TotalCostPriceBefore: $totalCostChange,
    99	            );
   100	            $this->entityManager->flush();
   101	            $this->entityManager->commit();
   102	        } catch (\Throwable $e) {
   103	            $this->entityManager->rollback();
   104	
   105	            throw $e;
   106	        }
   107	    }
   108	
   109	    private function processOne(
   110	        StockBulkApprovalItem $item,
   111	        DtbStockEditApproval $StockEditApproval,
   112	        MtbStockChangeTypeDetail $StockChangeTypeDetail,
   113	        Member $Member,
   114	    ): void {
   115	        $now = new \DateTime();
   116	        $ProductStock = $item->ProductStock;
   117	        $stockChangeQuantity = $item->stockChangeQuantity;
   118	        $purchaseUnitPrice = ($item->purchasePrice === null || $item->purchasePrice === '') ? '0' : $item->purchasePrice;
   119	
   120	        // 在庫編集承認情報詳細の作成
   121	        $this->stockEditApprovalDetailEntityManager->save(
   122	            StockEditApproval: $StockEditApproval,
   123	            ProductStock: $ProductStock,
   124	            editQuantity: (int) $stockChangeQuantity,
   125	            stockChangeReason: $item->stockChangeReason,
   126	            purchaseUnitPrice: $purchaseUnitPrice,
   127	            outboundTotalCost: $ProductStock->getMovementTotalCost($stockChangeQuantity),
   128	            beforeEditQuantity: (int) $ProductStock->getStock(),
   129	            beforePurchaseUnitPrice: $ProductStock->getUnitCost(),
   130	            Member: $Member
   131	        );
   132	
   133	        // 廃棄の場合のみ、在庫情報の更新を行う。
   134	        if ($StockChangeTypeDetail->isTypeDisposal()) {
   135	            $HistorySourceType = $this->stockHistorySourceTypeRepository->get(MtbStockHistorySourceType::STOCK_EDIT);
   136	            $sellPrice = (string) $ProductStock->getProductClass()->getPrice02();
   137	
   138	            $beforeStock = $ProductStock->getStock();
   139	            $totalCostPriceBefore = $ProductStock->getTotalCost();
   140	            $unitCostPriceBefore = $ProductStock->getUnitCost();
   141	
   142	            $afterStock = $ProductStock->getStockQuantityAfterChange($stockChangeQuantity);
   143	            $totalCostPriceAfter = $ProductStock->getTotalCostAfterChange($stockChangeQuantity);
   144	            $unitCostPriceAfter = $ProductStock->getUnitCostPriceAfterChange($stockChangeQuantity);
   145	
   146	            // 在庫情報の更新
   147	            $this->productStockEntityManager->save(
   148	                ProductStock: $ProductStock,
   149	                ProductClass: $ProductStock->getProductClass(),
   150	                BaseInfo: $ProductStock->getBaseInfo(),
   151	                stock: $afterStock,
   152	                pickUpFlg: $ProductStock->getPickUpFlg(),
   153	                stockLocationId: $ProductStock->getStockLocationId(),
   154	                totalCost: $totalCostPriceAfter,
   155	            );
   156	
   157	            // 在庫履歴の作成
   158	            $this->stockHistoryEntityManager->save(
   159	                ProductStock: $ProductStock,
   160	                StockChangeTypeDetail: $StockChangeTypeDetail,
   161	                oldStock: $beforeStock,
   162	                stock: $afterStock,
   163	                stockChangeQuantity: $stockChangeQuantity,
   164	                sellPrice: $sellPrice,
   165	                unitCostPriceBefore: $unitCostPriceBefore,
   166	                unitCostPriceAfter: $unitCostPriceAfter,
   167	                totalCostPriceBefore: $totalCostPriceBefore,
   168	                totalCostPriceAfter: $totalCostPriceAfter,
   169	                stockChangeReason: $item->stockChangeReason,
   170	                shortageReason: null,
   171	                HistorySourceType: $HistorySourceType,
   172	                historySourceId: $StockEditApproval->getId(),
   173	                registeredAt: $now,
   174	                RegisteredMember: $Member,// 登録者
   175	                operatorMemberName: $Member->getName(),
   176	            );
   177	        }
   178	    }

要求ID: sheet-3-R133
判定: 重複
主張: 管理画面の在庫操作を契機とするスマレジ在庫更新と件数上限が未実装としている。
実際: `src/Eccube/Service/Smaregi/Api/SmaregiStockApiClient.php:43` は店頭受取向けの `add`、同:51-53 は正数のみ許可し、同:86、128、158 は取得系APIである。`src/Eccube/Controller/Admin/Stock/StockListController.php:509-526` も選択IDを一括編集画面へ渡すだけである。これは sheet-3-R014 が指す実装欠陥と同一である。
修正案: sheet-3-R014へ畳む

要求ID: sheet-3-R163
判定: 重複
主張: 在庫変更CSVのスマレジ一括反映、非同期結果受信、EC在庫・CSV履歴への結果反映が未実装としている。
実際: `src/Eccube/Service/Smaregi/Api/SmaregiStockApiClient.php:43-183` にある公開処理は単品加算と取得系だけである。`src/Eccube/Service/Csv/Importer/Event/StockChangeCsvImportHandler.php:150-184` は入力CSVを1回S3へアップロードして履歴を1件登録するだけで、スマレジ一括登録やコールバック処理はない。これは sheet-3-R015 が指す実装欠陥と同一である。
修正案: sheet-3-R015へ畳む
